name: @aibast-agents-library/emission-tracking
sales_headline: Unify emissions evidence, threshold screening, reduction scenarios, and offset due diligence.
card_pitch: Creates a reviewable synthetic emissions view with threshold screening and planning scenarios, without validating claims or executing offsets.
customer_challenge: Emissions data is hard to unify, making compliance tracking slow, error-prone, and difficult to manage.
business_value: Creates a reviewable synthetic emissions view with threshold screening and planning scenarios, without validating claims or executing offsets.
why_try: Use the synthetic cases to evaluate routing, evidence quality, and approval boundaries before connecting customer systems.
safety_note: Decision support only; production writes require authenticated tools and explicit authorized human approval.
